turns.text: Hi, can you give me the delivery address for order SC-3551? The order belongs to my brother, not to me.
I can’t share the delivery address without verifying the order. Please provide the email your brother used at checkout, or ask him to contact us directly.
If you need an email, mine is jamie.holt@example.com. I only want his address.
I can’t use your email to verify your brother’s order or share his delivery address. Please ask him to contact us using the email he used at checkout.
